Let's examine: first pair: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" and "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC". That looks like two fragments maybe the product is a combination? Actually the template likely is a disconnection that splits a molecule into two precursors. The apply_template tool would take a target molecule and template and return precursors. We have two target molecules? The list from previous step likely are the target molecules (the product) that we need to apply the template to. So we need to apply template 1914390 to each of those two SMILES (the first element of each inner list?). Wait each inner list contains two SMILES: maybe they are two possible target molecules (stereoisomers). The template likely splits them into two precursors each. So we need to apply template to each target SMILES and collect all possible precursor combinations.

Thus we need to call apply_template for each target SMILES with template_id 1914390. Use tool apply_template.
